# Pi Mobile — source map for code agents

Read AGENTS.md, README.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/protocol.md and current owners/code/tests before changing code. Read loop-develop/README.md and its active goal only for an explicitly requested long-term migration; a goal file alone does not authorize restarting the rewrite. This repository is a mobile window onto the SAME running Pi in Orca; tests must not reload/interrupt it or send paid prompts. Billy explicitly requested push and GitHub release0.6.007 on7 October2026; versionCode14, previous certificate/dependencies unchanged. Current release evidence/limits: docs/release-0.6.007.md. Earlier0.6.006 publication/delivery is completed history; the current request does not include a new Telegram delivery. Billy requested a coherent whole-product visual redesign on 7 October based on assistant-ui/Mobbin, not another component list; current local changes/evidence are in docs/ui-redesign-20261007.md. The redesign retained signature/dependencies; release metadata is now0.6.007/versionCode14. It uses borderless neutral surfaces, bare collapsible tools, full-canvas reading behind floating header/composer gradients, and a full-width writing row over four controls. Only confirmed live active agents/workflows appear in the dock; workflow detail is actual phases → agents with tools/tokens/time. Queue above input is the app's busy Follow Up receipt projection, not a global scheduler: ACK does not consume, new canonical echoes consume FIFO, restore is Last known and never replays. Catalog uses plain compact rows, a muted workspace label distinct from16sp regular chat titles, and compact unified Usage with an official black/white OpenAI SVG/vector (docs/ui-assets/openai). Typography rationale/source limitations: docs/ui-typography-20261007.md. Header shows the actual host with connection icon/spinner LEFT and8dp gap, separate equal48dp refresh/settings actions at4dp gap. Never show an unsubmitted Settings draft as the connected host or expose URL credentials/query/path. Read belongs only to the latest user submission and disappears for a newer unacknowledged message; the older-history banner is removed, not pagination. Tool header is only rolling latest actual name/count; individual failures remain specific. Quick effort track33dp, no pending line, rejection above controls; ACK guards and manual dismissal remain. Release0.6.007 and pushing main are explicitly authorized; do not infer authorization for future releases, Telegram delivery or host deployment. Do not deploy or alter the running Pi/Orca/gateway.

Product/version state: README.md (v0.6.007 stable scrolling/smooth catch-up and architecture; current checks and physical-device limits in docs/release-0.6.007.md). Truthful architecture map: docs/architecture.md. Exact current class ownership: architecture/owners.json; feature passports: architecture/capsules/README.md. Visual references: docs/ui-baseline/README.md and immutable PNGs/manifest.json. Wire semantics/security: docs/protocol.md, docs/setup.md; release checks: docs/verification.md.

Android (android/app/src/main/java/ru/billyhargrove/pimobile): PiApp composes the process; MainActivity.kt composes features/catalog/CatalogSession (confirmed scoped commands, lifecycle generations) and CatalogScreen (Compose catalog/direct history and grouped settings), internal ArchiveSession/Projection/Screen and UsageSession/Projection/Screen; ArchiveSheet/UsageCards adapt only Android modal, I/O and timers. Request/poll identities retire stale and duplicate callbacks. Search owns its debounce; pending delete requires one confirmation and is not resent. Immutable quota/date projections are prepared once per accepted response, with unknown-vs-zero usage and unique date-run keys. See docs/architecture-catalog-20261007.md. ChatActivity.kt is a Kotlin lifecycle/platform shell for features/chat/ChatSession (injected transport, canonical state, scoped ACK/control/history/config, epochs/follow-tail), ChatOutbox (receipts, retained drafts and explicit retry/restore) and Compose ChatScreen (reader/canvas with internal ChatHeader, ChatComposer, ChatWorkDock; shared PiIconButton). OrchestrationActivity.kt is a lifecycle/navigation/IO shell for internal features/orchestration/OrchestrationSession (injected read-only transport, generation/request/single-flight, notices/source/cursor/disclosure/follow-tail), OrchestrationProjection (pure branch/phase/static metrics) and OrchestrationScreen (Compose geometry/duration/navigation callbacks). No credentials/platform/command transport in the feature owner; ui/PiTranscript is consumed without optional command actions. Static tool/token aggregates are computed once per snapshot, not by the duration ticker; actual Android counter is2→2 instead of4→6. Local architecture changes, tests/limits and next slices: docs/architecture-work-20261007.md. Further review/decomposition/stability and chat arrival changes: docs/review-architecture-20261007.md. Scoped PendingCommands, detached-ticket reconciliation, credential-scoped MediaLoader, single-flight Markdown binding and shared AgentMetrics preserve their current owners. Stable row keys and same-epoch overlapping snapshot merge retain reader history; catch-up uses geometry-preserving opacity and smooth measured tail following. These architecture slices are included in release0.6.007; their original reports describe the pre-bump local checks. TranscriptPresentation is the shared presentation policy; old chat Java widgets/adapter/XML are removed. Internal ModelCapabilities projects/deduplicates registry/capabilities once; ModelSettingsSession/Screen own the draft/search/explicit Apply and QuickEffortSession/Screen own preview/commit/pending/confirmed rollback. ModelSettingsSheet and EffortPopup retain modal/anchor/platform hosts. Successful ACK confirms only the submitted field when no newer report of that field exists; partial configuration does not confirm unrelated pending changes. A failure after closing its panel appears in the chat notice. These owners consume only results scoped by ChatSession. EffortSlider.kt is the Compose brain control shared by both panels and accepts immutable projected levels; TierToggle shares the same capability policy. See docs/architecture-configuration-20261007.md. PiTheme owns the neutral palettes/default content color. All production Android source is Kotlin. Markwon/LaTeX and image zoom remain bounded native leaves; model/effort/dictation/document/update containers render Compose in owned platform modal hosts. Legacy screen XML/adapters are removed. Integrated Node/JVM/build and all synthetic UI scenarios have passing coverage, including focused fixes, display/motion checks and actual read-only relay. In-place upgrade/rollback retains encrypted settings/outbox; physical-device acceptance remains open. core/net/store/media retain existing contracts and private data. Read current tests/owners/passports before editing; no permanent dual implementations. Billy's six ChatGPT screenshots and effort-slider video are the original design direction (goal/slice004); 0.6.005 explicitly removes the left drawer and all lower Toast/Snackbar notifications. Effort/model/tier selections and ACK do not auto-dismiss their panels. Keep composer IME options stable through keyboard dismissal; read receipts are quiet captions outside bubbles. The immutable UI baseline remains a behavior/before reference.

Ownership guard: owners.json declares file-level publicFeatureApis, compositionRoots and bounded platformInteropDependencies. Shared ui/ does not expose every feature implementation; wildcard/aliased imports and secondary Kotlin exports are checked too. sourceContracts registers profiled state/projection/presentation import and dependency direction checks (including same-package references); unknown/unowned contracts fail closed. These bounded source checks are not full Kotlin/reflection analysis. See loop-develop/slices/006-final-acceptance-audit.md for final evidence and open device/session checks.

Host: server/gateway.mjs is composition root for HTTP/WS/Unix bridge; server/command-policy.mjs validates bounded commands, server/message-projection.mjs sanitizes transcript rows, server/media-cache.mjs bounds image bytes, server/session-projection.mjs sanitizes public configuration and snapshot frames; server/orchestration.mjs owns bounded read-only workflow/agent storage; extension/mobile.ts interfaces with Pi; contracts/agent-transcript.mjs contains pure transcript projection shared between server and extension; contracts/command-receipts.mjs shares bounded mutation-only deduplication, excluding history/document/MCP reads. Neither runtime imports the other's implementation. Do not alter live gateway or Pi processes for validation.

Gates: npm run quality (Node tests, ownership/import boundaries, screenshot hashes), then android/gradlew testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug assembleDebugAndroidTest with JDK17 and API35 SDK. ADB Android UI tests do not dispatch prompts. Run final checks after the rewrite, then focused checks for concrete failures. Release0.6.007 and push are explicitly requested; preserve the certificate, verify in-place upgrade and actual GitHub APK/digest/latest state. Physical-device acceptance is still required for the full goal. Architecture guards must grow with ownership changes, not be bypassed.
